title: Did a Chola King's Own City Kill Him? | Athirajendra, 1070 #shorts

lines.text: Did a Chola king's own city kill him?
Ten seventy. Athirajendra had just been crowned Chola king, and his capital was in revolt.

lines.text: Athirajendra was killed. His reign had lasted only months.
